items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1966-01-20
items.q: Peter Bocards is the honest man around here that I know now

ctx.x: What about quadrilles? Were they playing any quadrilles when you started?

Not when I started. Well, yeah, they were playing, but I mean I wasn't. They were still dancing, quadrilles, shatters, and walls. But I never played quadrilles. During my time, coming along, the quadrilles was going out. And now and then somebody will hire a band and ask them, can they play a quadrilles? Well, if they never played it, they can't play it. And Peter Bocards is the honest man around here that I know now that might have a couple of sets of quadrilles that he could rent to a band, you know, or play…
